events.verdict: Bassey (GSW) does not maintain a legal guarding position in Raynaud's (SAC) path when body contact occurs, affecting Raynaud's SQBR after his gather.
Raynaud (SAC) uses two hands to deliver contact, affecting Bassey's (GSW) body's trajectory during his shot attempt in the post.
After Bassey (GSW) clears, he is then in the lane again for less than three seconds before the pass is dislodged.
Leons (GSW) makes direct contact with the ball to dislodge the ball prior to any incidental contact occurring with Cardwell (SAC).
Raynaud (SAC) initiates contact with Santos' (GSW) arm, which affects his layup attempt.
Spencer (GSW) reaches for the ball when he delivers contact to Plowden (SAC) in the backcourt, affecting Plowden's SQBR.
Carter (SAC) lunges toward the pass when marginal body contact occurs with Podziemski (GSW), which he moves through on the perimeter.
Podziemski (GSW) makes incidental hand-on-ball contact with Cardwell (SAC) as Cardwell finishes the layup attempt.
Carter (SAC) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds. Possession correctly remains with GSW.
Podziemski (GSW) is moving alongside Clifford's (SAC) path when marginal body contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Santos (GSW) initiates contact with Clifford's (SAC) arm, and the contact affects his ability to control the ball.
Carter (SAC) aligns alongside Podziemski's (GSW) path and removes his resting hand when marginal contact occurs during Podziemski's driving shot attempt.
Plowden's (SAC) resting hand comes out slightly when marginal contact occurs with Bassey (GSW) during the rebound.
Carter (SAC) gets his hand to the ball to initially dislodge the incoming pass before marginal contact occurs with Spencer (GSW).
Cardwell (SAC) is drawn into the air toward Podziemski (GSW) when arm and body contact occur, which affects Podziemski's shot attempt.
